Agents selected an older or unsuitable cache result, searched instead of refining, or resent criteria already covered.

patch.reasoning: Most observed omissions and cache mistakes are already directly covered by the skill, so adding reminders would duplicate existing rules. One genuine ambiguity remains: the skill forbids borrowing hotel dates from flight dates, while the expected plans treat an explicitly stated overall trip date range as the lodging stay. Clarifying that distinction supports those plans without permitting guesses from a single flight leg or vague context.

edits.target: Hotel check-in and check-out dates must be explicit; do not borrow them from flight dates or infer a neighborhood.
edits.content: Hotel check-in and check-out must come from explicit stay dates or an explicitly stated overall trip date range: when lodging is part of the same trip and the user gives outbound/departure and return dates as the trip’s start and end, use those as check-in and check-out unless distinct hotel dates are stated. Do not derive a stay from a single flight leg, an event date, or vague duration, and do not infer a neighborhood.
